note: Each record is one line of one party page, matched to one race and one candidate on the official lists already loaded (office, place and name all fit, one fit only). The same endorsement often stands on several lists (the state party's list and a unit's own page): count a candidate once per party. 'election' appears only when the candidate is on a primary list and not on the November list. Support that a page itself says is not an endorsement (a DFL letter of support, a recommendation, a bare listing) is under other_support with the page's own word in 'kind', never under endorsements. Federal offices on these pages are outside this file. Every page in 'lists' was opened again after it was read, and a record is kept only if the page still showed it. 'held_for_john' holds what was read from a page whose site asks programs not to read it: nothing there is used until John says so. 'not_read' names the units whose pages could not, or should not, be read, and what was left out on purpose.
